---
title: "Lightbox: descriptions"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/addtl/example.qmd. A
# `description` attribute is parsed as markdown into a hidden
# `div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-<n>` at the end of the body, and the
# link points GLightbox at it via `data-glightbox`. `desc-position` is
# forwarded to the link as a data attribute.
lightbox: auto
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'div.hidden[aria-hidden="true"] > div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-1'
          - 'div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-1 em'
          - 'div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-1 a[href="https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps"]'
          - 'div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-3'
          - 'a.lightbox[data-desc-position="left"] > img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox[data-gallery="elsewhere"] > img[src="images/mv-1.png"]'
        - - 'img[description]'
          - 'img[data-description]'
          - 'img[data-desc-position]'
          - 'div.lightbox-desc-2'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - "data-glightbox=\"description: .lightbox-desc-1;title:Beach in Chilmark;\""
          - "data-glightbox=\"description: .lightbox-desc-3;title:Oak Bluffs;\""
        - []
---
